input.title: Women's Christmas – Frenchie I'm Helping. You're Welcome. Tee
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

I'm helping, you're welcome: a Frenchie T-shirt for anyone who has wrapped a present around a French Bulldog sitting on the paper. Wear it on gift-wrapping night, at the tree or on Christmas morning, and let the dog take the credit.

The art is a 1950s Christmas-card scene: a brindle French Bulldog with big upright bat ears sits proudly, chest out, on a half-unrolled sheet of red-and-cream striped wrapping paper, a strip of clear tape stuck to one ear and a curly green ribbon tangled around its front leg. Beside it are the paper roll, a closed pair of scissors and a few loose green bows. I'M HELPING. runs across the top in tall deep-red capitals and YOU'RE WELCOME. stacks across the bottom in pine green; on the dark shirts they turn cream and mustard, and the scene gets a cream outline.

It makes an easy gift for the Frenchie owner who has lost a roll of tape to a helper, from a partner, a sister or the dog walker, and it suits a frenchie christmas wrapping session. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Relaxed fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: White, Natural, Pink, Heather Stone, Black, Navy, Maroon, Forest Green
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras, or the US

Questions

How does the I'm Helping. You're Welcome. tee fit?
The I'm Helping. You're Welcome. tee from Graphic Tees Co. is a Bella+Canvas 6400 relaxed women's cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy fit or go up one for an oversized, cozy look. Compare the size chart with a tee you already own, and the first exchange is free.

What is it made of and how do I wash it?
It is 100% combed, ring-spun cotton at a lightweight 4.2 oz/yd², pre-shrunk with side seams; the heather colors contain polyester. Turn the Graphic Tees Co. tee inside out, wash it cold with similar colors and tumble dry low. Skip bleach so the red, green and mustard inks stay bright.

What colors does it come in and how is it printed?
It comes in White, Natural, Pink and Heather Stone with a deep red headline and pine green punch line, and in Black, Navy, Maroon and Forest Green with a cream headline, mustard punch line and a cream outline around the dog. Graphic Tees Co. prints each tee to order in sizes S through 3XL.

Who is it a good gift for?
It is a good gift for anyone who has tried to wrap a present with a French Bulldog on the paper: a partner, a sister, or the friend whose dog supervises every Christmas job. Graphic Tees Co. prints it to order, orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess.

When should I order it for Christmas?
Order by about December 8 so the I'm Helping. You're Welcome. tee from Graphic Tees Co. arrives before Christmas. Each shirt is printed to order, which takes a few business days, then ships within the US. A misprint or damaged shirt is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.
